description: Cross-Game Crafting Reference — Sims 4, Ark, Minecraft mapped to Trench-Builder

entries.constraint: Minecraft: 1 log = 4 planks instant. TB: requires sawmill station.
entries.gap: TB adds extraction station requirement

entries.constraint: Minecraft: furnace refinement. TB: stone is raw resource.
entries.gap: TB simplifies — stone is directly buildable

entries.constraint: Minecraft: 1 ore = 1 ingot. TB: 2 ore + 1 coal = 1 ingot (more realistic).
entries.gap: TB adds coal as catalyst, higher input cost

entries.constraint: Minecraft: diamond tier. TB: alloy tier (no gems).
entries.gap: TB replaces magic gems with metallurgy

entries.constraint: 5 tiers. TB mirrors with same count but realistic materials.
entries.gap: TB drops gem/magic tiers for industrial metallurgy

entries.constraint: Minecraft: free crafting. TB: gated by skill tree + material cost.
entries.gap: TB adds skill level gates to recipe access

entries.constraint: Minecraft: one furnace for everything. TB: separate stations per material class.
entries.gap: TB splits smelting by material type (more realistic)
Critical gap — no automation system. Priority: HIGH
Economy system needed. Priority: MEDIUM
Modification/enhancement system. Priority: LOW

entries.constraint: Ark: engram points per level-up. TB: XP-based skill tree.
entries.gap: TB simplifies — skill levels replace engram point economy

entries.constraint: 5 tiers each. Ark: tek = sci-fi. TB: composite = realistic.
entries.gap: TB replaces sci-fi tier with composite materials

entries.tb_equivalent: hand->tool (gather tools: axe, pickaxe, shovel, sickle)
entries.constraint: Ark: dino harvesting is primary. TB: tool-only (no dinos).
entries.gap: TB replaces creature harvesting with tool specialization
Creature system not in scope. Priority: LOW

entries.tb_equivalent: workbench, forge, kiln, smelter, chemistry_station, loom, sawmill, kitchen, lab
entries.constraint: Ark: 3-4 stations. TB: 9 stations with material-type specialization.
entries.gap: TB has more granular station specialization

entries.item: build mode: wall tool + room tool
entries.gap: TB replaces visual building with crafting-driven construction

entries.item: furniture categories: seating, surfaces, storage, sleeping, lighting, decorative, outdoor, office, kitchen, bathroom
entries.constraint: Sims: catalog of 1000+ items. TB: 50+ procedural/generated items.
entries.gap: TB needs 30 more furniture (bathroom, kitchen, lighting, decorative, outdoor, office)

entries.item: appliance states: off, on, running, broken
entries.tb_equivalent: CP2 state machines: off, on, running, overload, broken
entries.constraint: Sims: states trigger emotional buffs. TB: states trigger power grid load.
entries.gap: TB replaces emotional system with power grid integration

entries.item: room types: bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living, dining, study, gym, nursery
entries.gap: Room classification system. Priority: LOW
Out of scope for survival/builder genre

entries.item: build mode constraints: grid snap, wall height, floor levels
entries.constraint: Sims: aesthetic constraints. TB: structural/physics constraints.
entries.gap: TB adds real-world engineering constraints to construction
Resource respawn system. Priority: MEDIUM

entries.constraint: Minecraft: tool tier >= block tier. TB: specific tool per resource type.
entries.gap: TB maps tools to resources, not tiers to blocks
Storage/logistics system. Priority: MEDIUM
Snap/grid placement for construction. Priority: HIGH
